subhero.en: Generic Truvada (emtricitabine/tenofovir) costs $27 to $70 per month with a discount coupon in 2026, while brand Descovy runs about $2,392 per month and Apretude costs $4,229 per bimonthly injection with no insurance. The good news: since a September 2024 Medicare National Coverage Determination and a parallel Affordable Care Act preventive-services mandate, most Medicare beneficiaries and ACA-compliant private plans now cover all four FDA-approved PrEP products, Truvada, Descovy, Apretude, and the newer twice-yearly Yeztugo, at $0 out-of-pocket cost. The federal Ready, Set, PrEP program that once supplied free medication to the uninsured ended in July 2025; this page covers what replaced it, the current cash prices, and how to apply for manufacturer patient assistance in 2026.
subhero.es: El Truvada generico (emtricitabina/tenofovir) cuesta $27 a $70 por mes con un cupon de descuento en 2026, mientras que Descovy de marca cuesta aproximadamente $2,392 por mes y Apretude cuesta $4,229 por inyeccion bimestral sin seguro. La buena noticia: desde una Determinacion Nacional de Cobertura de Medicare de septiembre de 2024 y un mandato paralelo de servicios preventivos de la Ley del Cuidado de Salud a Bajo Precio, la mayoria de los beneficiarios de Medicare y los planes privados que cumplen con la ACA ahora cubren los cuatro productos PrEP aprobados por la FDA a $0 de costo de bolsillo. El programa federal Ready, Set, PrEP que alguna vez suministro medicamentos gratis a personas sin seguro termino en julio de 2025; esta pagina cubre lo que lo reemplazo.

quickAnswer.en: Without insurance in 2026, generic Truvada costs $27 to $70 per month, brand Descovy costs about $2,392 per month, Apretude (cabotegravir) costs $4,229 per bimonthly injection, and the new twice-yearly Yeztugo (lenacapavir) costs $14,109 per dose. Most people never pay these prices: Medicare Part B has covered all FDA-approved PrEP forms at $0 cost-sharing since a September 30, 2024 National Coverage Determination, and Affordable Care Act preventive-services rules require most employer and Marketplace plans to cover Truvada, Descovy, and Apretude, plus required HIV testing and kidney-function labs, at $0 as well. Medicaid covers PrEP in every state, typically for $0 to $4 per prescription. The federal Ready, Set, PrEP program, which once shipped free medication to uninsured patients, stopped enrolling new patients on July 30, 2024 and fully closed on July 18, 2025; uninsured patients today should apply instead to Gilead Advancing Access (Truvada, Descovy, Yeztugo) or the ViiV Healthcare Patient Assistance Program through GSKPAF (Apretude), both of which offer free medication for household income at or below approximately 500% of the federal poverty level.
quickAnswer.es: Sin seguro en 2026, el Truvada generico cuesta $27 a $70 por mes, Descovy de marca cuesta aproximadamente $2,392 por mes, Apretude (cabotegravir) cuesta $4,229 por inyeccion bimestral, y el nuevo Yeztugo (lenacapavir) de dos veces al ano cuesta $14,109 por dosis. La mayoria de las personas nunca pagan estos precios: Medicare Parte B ha cubierto todas las formas de PrEP aprobadas por la FDA a $0 de costo compartido desde una Determinacion Nacional de Cobertura del 30 de septiembre de 2024, y las reglas de servicios preventivos de la ACA exigen que la mayoria de los planes de empleador y del Mercado cubran Truvada, Descovy y Apretude, mas las pruebas de VIH y laboratorios de funcion renal requeridos, tambien a $0. Medicaid cubre la PrEP en todos los estados, generalmente por $0 a $4 por receta. El programa federal Ready, Set, PrEP, que alguna vez envio medicamento gratis a pacientes sin seguro, dejo de inscribir nuevos pacientes el 30 de julio de 2024 y cerro por completo el 18 de julio de 2025; los pacientes sin seguro hoy deben solicitar Gilead Advancing Access (Truvada, Descovy, Yeztugo) o el Programa de Asistencia al Paciente de ViiV Healthcare a traves de GSKPAF (Apretude), ambos con ingresos familiares de hasta aproximadamente el 500% del nivel federal de pobreza.

introParagraphs.en: Truvada, Descovy, Apretude, and Yeztugo are the four FDA-approved medications for HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis, commonly called PrEP, a daily pill or periodic injection that reduces the risk of getting HIV from sex by about 99 percent when taken as prescribed. Truvada (emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate) was the first PrEP drug approved, in 2012, and has been available as a generic since October 2020. Descovy (emtricitabine/tenofovir alafenamide) followed in October 2019 but is FDA-approved only for people at risk through anal sex, not for people whose only risk is receptive vaginal sex. Apretude (cabotegravir) is a long-acting injectable given every two months, approved in December 2021. Yeztugo (lenacapavir), approved June 18, 2025, is the newest option, an injection given only twice a year.
introParagraphs.es: Truvada, Descovy, Apretude y Yeztugo son los cuatro medicamentos aprobados por la FDA para la profilaxis previa a la exposicion al VIH, comunmente llamada PrEP, una pastilla diaria o inyeccion periodica que reduce el riesgo de contraer VIH por relaciones sexuales en aproximadamente un 99 por ciento cuando se toma como se receta. Truvada (emtricitabina/tenofovir disoproxil fumarato) fue el primer medicamento PrEP aprobado, en 2012, y ha estado disponible como generico desde octubre de 2020. Descovy (emtricitabina/tenofovir alafenamida) le siguio en octubre de 2019 pero esta aprobado por la FDA solo para personas en riesgo por sexo anal, no para personas cuyo unico riesgo sea el sexo vaginal receptivo. Apretude (cabotegravir) es un inyectable de accion prolongada administrado cada dos meses, aprobado en diciembre de 2021. Yeztugo (lenacapavir), aprobado el 18 de junio de 2025, es la opcion mas nueva, una inyeccion administrada solo dos veces al ano.

introParagraphs.en: Federal policy changed the PrEP cost picture dramatically for 2026. CMS issued a final National Coverage Determination on September 30, 2024 that moved all FDA-approved PrEP drugs, oral and injectable, out of Medicare Part D and into Medicare Part A and Part B with zero cost-sharing, including coverage for up to eight HIV tests per year, up to eight counseling sessions per year, and an annual hepatitis B screening. Separately, the Affordable Care Act's preventive-services mandate under Public Health Service Act Section 2713, based on a USPSTF Grade A recommendation, requires most employer-sponsored and Marketplace plans to cover Truvada, Descovy, and Apretude, along with required lab monitoring, without any deductible, copay, or coinsurance. Insurers have been gradually adding Yeztugo to that zero-cost-share list since its 2025 approval; confirm your plan's current formulary before your first fill.
introParagraphs.es: La politica federal cambio drasticamente el panorama de costos de la PrEP para 2026. CMS emitio una Determinacion Nacional de Cobertura final el 30 de septiembre de 2024 que traslado todos los medicamentos PrEP aprobados por la FDA, orales e inyectables, de Medicare Parte D a Medicare Parte A y Parte B sin costo compartido, incluyendo cobertura de hasta ocho pruebas de VIH por ano, hasta ocho sesiones de consejeria por ano y una prueba anual de hepatitis B. Por separado, el mandato de servicios preventivos de la ACA bajo la Seccion 2713 de la Ley de Servicio de Salud Publica exige que la mayoria de los planes patrocinados por empleadores y del Mercado cubran Truvada, Descovy y Apretude, junto con el monitoreo de laboratorio requerido, sin deducible, copago ni coseguro.

introParagraphs.en: Ready, Set, PrEP was the first nationwide HHS program offering free PrEP medication to uninsured Americans, launched in 2019. The program stopped accepting new enrollments on July 30, 2024 and fully closed on July 18, 2025, a shutdown that coincided with Gilead discontinuing its own free-generic-Truvada program in January 2025. No direct federal replacement exists as of 2026. Uninsured patients now have four main paths to free or low-cost PrEP: the Gilead Advancing Access program for Truvada, Descovy, and Yeztugo; the ViiV Healthcare Patient Assistance Program through GSKPAF for Apretude; state-run PrEP assistance programs currently operating in about a dozen states; and the roughly 15,000 Federally Qualified Health Centers nationwide that offer sliding-fee PrEP regardless of insurance or immigration status. Patients comparing options for weight-loss or diabetes drugs facing similar manufacturer-assistance questions can also review the [manufacturer coupon rules on the Ozempic cost page](/en/drug/ozempic-cost), since the same anti-kickback restrictions apply here.
introParagraphs.es: Ready, Set, PrEP fue el primer programa nacional de HHS que ofrecio medicamento PrEP gratis a estadounidenses sin seguro, lanzado en 2019. El programa dejo de aceptar nuevas inscripciones el 30 de julio de 2024 y cerro por completo el 18 de julio de 2025, un cierre que coincidio con que Gilead descontinuara su propio programa de Truvada generico gratis en enero de 2025. No existe un reemplazo federal directo a partir de 2026. Los pacientes sin seguro ahora tienen cuatro caminos principales hacia la PrEP gratis o de bajo costo: el programa Gilead Advancing Access para Truvada, Descovy y Yeztugo; el Programa de Asistencia al Paciente de ViiV Healthcare a traves de GSKPAF para Apretude; programas estatales de asistencia PrEP que operan actualmente en aproximadamente una docena de estados; y los aproximadamente 15,000 Centros de Salud Calificados Federalmente en todo el pais que ofrecen PrEP con tarifa segun ingresos sin importar el seguro o estatus migratorio.

paragraphs.en: Hospitals and emergency departments rarely administer routine PrEP, since it is a preventive, self-managed outpatient regimen rather than an acute treatment. When a facility does dispense a bridge supply, for example a patient starting PrEP after a same-day risk assessment in an emergency department, the charge can include a facility fee, a pharmacy dispensing fee, and a physician evaluation charge stacked on top of the drug's acquisition cost. A single Apretude injection given in a hospital-based clinic can be billed at several thousand dollars once facility overhead is added, even though the same dose costs $4,229 or less at a specialty pharmacy and $0 for most insured patients under 2026 coverage rules.
paragraphs.es: Los hospitales y salas de emergencia rara vez administran PrEP de rutina, ya que es un regimen ambulatorio preventivo y autoadministrado en lugar de un tratamiento agudo. Cuando una instalacion dispensa un suministro puente, por ejemplo un paciente que inicia PrEP tras una evaluacion de riesgo el mismo dia en una sala de emergencias, el cargo puede incluir una tarifa de instalacion, una tarifa de farmacia y un cargo por evaluacion medica sumados al costo de adquisicion del medicamento.

paragraphs.en: Emergency departments sometimes confuse PrEP with post-exposure prophylaxis (PEP), the 28-day emergency regimen started within 72 hours of a specific exposure. PEP is billed and covered differently than PrEP and typically costs more upfront because it is dispensed as an urgent, short-course treatment rather than a routine preventive prescription. Patients who received a large ED bill after starting HIV prevention medication should ask specifically whether they were billed for PrEP or PEP, since PrEP should be a $0 charge under Medicare Part B or an ACA-compliant plan, while PEP cost-sharing rules can differ by insurer.
paragraphs.es: Las salas de emergencia a veces confunden la PrEP con la profilaxis posterior a la exposicion (PEP), el regimen de emergencia de 28 dias que se inicia dentro de las 72 horas de una exposicion especifica. La PEP se factura y cubre de manera diferente a la PrEP y generalmente cuesta mas por adelantado porque se dispensa como un tratamiento urgente de corto plazo en lugar de una receta preventiva de rutina.

intro.en: Apretude and Yeztugo are administered in a clinical setting and billed with specific HCPCS Level II J-codes under Medicare Part B. Oral Truvada and Descovy, dispensed at a retail pharmacy, are typically billed by National Drug Code (NDC) rather than a J-code, even though the National Coverage Determination places them under Part B for cost-sharing purposes.
intro.es: Apretude y Yeztugo se administran en un entorno clinico y se facturan con codigos J especificos de HCPCS Nivel II bajo Medicare Parte B. Truvada y Descovy orales, dispensados en una farmacia minorista, generalmente se facturan por Codigo Nacional de Medicamento (NDC) en lugar de un codigo J.

howToApplyPap.programName: Gilead Advancing Access (representative example for Truvada, Descovy, and Yeztugo; ViiV's GSKPAF program for Apretude follows similar steps)

numberedSteps.en: Step 1: Call 1-800-226-2056 or visit gileadadvancingaccess.com (for Truvada, Descovy, or Yeztugo) or gskpaf.org/viiv (for Apretude) to confirm eligibility before completing paperwork.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 1: Llame al 1-800-226-2056 o visite gileadadvancingaccess.com o gskpaf.org/viiv para confirmar elegibilidad antes de completar el papeleo.

numberedSteps.en: Step 2: Download the patient enrollment form from the program website. Complete the patient section with household income, household size, and insurance status; have your prescriber complete and sign the prescriber section.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 2: Descargue el formulario de inscripcion del paciente del sitio web del programa. Complete la seccion del paciente y haga que su medico prescriptor complete y firme la seccion correspondiente.

numberedSteps.en: Step 3: Gather required documents: proof of household income (recent pay stubs or a tax return), proof of US residency, a valid prescription for the specific PrEP drug, and confirmation that you have no other prescription drug coverage for it.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 3: Reuna los documentos requeridos: comprobante de ingresos, comprobante de residencia en EE.UU., una receta valida y confirmacion de que no tiene otra cobertura de medicamentos para ese medicamento.

numberedSteps.en: Step 4: Submit the completed application by fax, mail, or the program's online portal. Processing typically takes 5 to 10 business days.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 4: Envie la solicitud completa por fax, correo o el portal en linea del programa. El procesamiento generalmente toma 5 a 10 dias habiles.

numberedSteps.en: Step 5: If approved, the manufacturer ships the medication directly to your home or your prescriber's office at no charge. Re-enrollment is typically required every 12 months with updated income documentation.
numberedSteps.es: Paso 5: Si es aprobado, el fabricante envia el medicamento directamente a su domicilio o al consultorio de su prescriptor sin cargo. La reinscripcion generalmente se requiere cada 12 meses.

documentsNeeded.en: Proof of household income (recent pay stubs, tax return, or a signed self-attestation form for patients with no income)
documentsNeeded.es: Comprobante de ingresos familiares (recibos de pago recientes, declaracion de impuestos o autodeclaracion firmada)

documentsNeeded.en: Proof of US residency (utility bill, lease agreement, or ID); no Social Security number is required for Gilead Advancing Access
documentsNeeded.es: Comprobante de residencia en EE.UU.; no se requiere numero de Seguro Social para Gilead Advancing Access

documentsNeeded.en: Valid prescription for the specific PrEP drug from a US-licensed prescriber
documentsNeeded.es: Receta valida para el medicamento PrEP especifico de un prescriptor con licencia en EE.UU.

documentsNeeded.en: Completed and signed prescriber section of the application
documentsNeeded.es: Seccion del prescriptor completa y firmada de la solicitud

documentsNeeded.en: Documentation showing no other prescription drug coverage for the specific drug
documentsNeeded.es: Documentacion que muestre que no tiene otra cobertura de medicamentos para ese medicamento especifico

commonDenialReasons.en: Household income exceeds the approximately 500% FPL threshold for the program
commonDenialReasons.es: Los ingresos familiares superan el umbral de aproximadamente 500% FPL del programa

commonDenialReasons.en: Incomplete application or missing prescriber signature
commonDenialReasons.es: Solicitud incompleta o falta la firma del prescriptor

commonDenialReasons.en: Patient is enrolled in Medicaid or another government drug plan that already covers the medication at low or no cost
commonDenialReasons.es: El paciente esta inscrito en Medicaid u otro plan de medicamentos del gobierno que ya cubre el medicamento

commonDenialReasons.en: Prescription written by a prescriber not licensed in the United States
commonDenialReasons.es: Receta escrita por un prescriptor sin licencia en Estados Unidos

paragraphs.en: Medicare stopped covering PrEP under Part D in 2024. CMS's September 30, 2024 National Coverage Determination moved Truvada, Descovy, Apretude, and later Yeztugo out of the Part D prescription drug benefit entirely and into Medicare Part A and Part B as a preventive service, meaning the annual Part D out-of-pocket cap of $2,100 for 2026 simply does not apply to PrEP; there is no deductible, copay, or coinsurance to track because the cost is $0 from the first fill.
paragraphs.es: Medicare dejo de cubrir la PrEP bajo la Parte D en 2024. La Determinacion Nacional de Cobertura de CMS del 30 de septiembre de 2024 traslado a Truvada, Descovy, Apretude y luego Yeztugo por completo del beneficio de medicamentos recetados de la Parte D a Medicare Parte A y Parte B como un servicio preventivo, lo que significa que el limite anual de bolsillo de la Parte D de $2,100 para 2026 simplemente no aplica a la PrEP.

paragraphs.en: Beneficiaries who see a Part D claim or a copay on their Explanation of Benefits for Truvada, Descovy, Apretude, or Yeztugo in 2026 should contact their plan immediately; that claim was very likely processed under the wrong benefit. The Medicare Rights Center and 1-800-MEDICARE can help beneficiaries get an incorrectly billed PrEP claim reprocessed as a $0 Part B preventive service rather than a Part D drug claim. Because PrEP no longer sits on a Part D formulary tier, none of the four drugs has a Medicare Maximum Fair Price under the Inflation Reduction Act of 2022; none was selected for IRA negotiation, and none needed to be, since the $0 preventive-service benefit already makes the negotiated-price mechanism unnecessary for Medicare beneficiaries on PrEP.
paragraphs.es: Los beneficiarios que vean un reclamo de la Parte D o un copago en su Explicacion de Beneficios por Truvada, Descovy, Apretude o Yeztugo en 2026 deben contactar a su plan de inmediato; es muy probable que ese reclamo se haya procesado bajo el beneficio equivocado. Debido a que la PrEP ya no esta en un nivel de formulario de la Parte D, ninguno de los cuatro medicamentos tiene un Precio Maximo Justo de Medicare bajo la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion de 2022; ninguno fue seleccionado para la negociacion IRA, y no lo necesitaba, ya que el beneficio preventivo de $0 ya hace innecesario el mecanismo de precio negociado.

intro.en: PrEP billing errors are common in 2026 because the 2024 Medicare and ACA coverage changes are still being implemented across pharmacy and clinic systems. Watch for these issues:
intro.es: Los errores de facturacion de PrEP son comunes en 2026 porque los cambios de cobertura de Medicare y la ACA de 2024 aun se estan implementando. Este atento a estos problemas:

items.en: Any Medicare copay, coinsurance, or Part D charge for Truvada, Descovy, Apretude, or Yeztugo in 2026, since all four should process at $0 under the Part B PrEP National Coverage Determination.
items.es: Cualquier copago, coseguro o cargo de Parte D por Truvada, Descovy, Apretude o Yeztugo en 2026, ya que los cuatro deberian procesarse a $0.

items.en: A cost-sharing charge on an ACA-compliant employer or Marketplace plan for Truvada, Descovy, or Apretude, which violates the preventive-services mandate unless the plan is a grandfathered or excepted plan not subject to ACA rules.
items.es: Un cargo de costo compartido en un plan de empleador o del Mercado que cumple con la ACA por Truvada, Descovy o Apretude, lo cual viola el mandato de servicios preventivos.

items.en: PEP (post-exposure prophylaxis) billed and charged as if it were routine PrEP, or the reverse; the two have different indications and different cost-sharing treatment at some insurers.
items.es: PEP (profilaxis posterior a la exposicion) facturada como si fuera PrEP de rutina, o al reves; las dos tienen indicaciones diferentes y trato de costo compartido diferente en algunas aseguradoras.

items.en: Apretude billed under J0741 (the cabotegravir/rilpivirine HIV-treatment combination code) instead of the correct PrEP-specific code J0739, which can trigger an incorrect denial or cost-sharing charge.
items.es: Apretude facturado bajo J0741 en lugar del codigo especifico de PrEP J0739, lo que puede generar una denegacion incorrecta.

items.en: Manufacturer copay card applied for a Medicare or Medicaid beneficiary, which is prohibited by federal anti-kickback law and can result in a clawback of the claim later.
items.es: Tarjeta de copago del fabricante aplicada a un beneficiario de Medicare o Medicaid, lo cual esta prohibido por la ley federal anti-soborno.

items.en: Required HIV testing, kidney-function labs, or counseling visits billed separately with a copay when they should be bundled into the $0 PrEP preventive-service benefit.
items.es: Pruebas de VIH requeridas, laboratorios de funcion renal o sesiones de consejeria facturadas por separado con copago cuando deberian estar incluidas en el beneficio preventivo de $0.

genericBiosimilarStatus.genericName: emtricitabine/tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (generic Truvada, marketed since October 2020)

note.en: The four PrEP drugs have four different generic outcomes. Truvada has had full generic competition since October 2020, with multiple manufacturers selling emtricitabine/tenofovir DF for $27 to $70 per month via discount coupon, over 95 percent below the pre-generic brand price. Descovy has no generic sold in the US as of 2026; the FDA has granted tentative approval to several generic applicants, but patent settlement agreements between Gilead and generic manufacturers are expected to keep generic Descovy off pharmacy shelves until somewhere between 2032 and 2036, depending on the specific settlement. Apretude and Yeztugo are small-molecule drugs, not biologics, so the biosimilar approval pathway does not apply to either; both are protected by long-acting-formulation patents in addition to the underlying molecule patent, and neither has an announced US generic timeline. A global licensing deal announced in September 2025 will make generic lenacapavir available for about $40 per person per year in roughly 120 lower-income countries starting in 2027, but that pricing does not extend to the US market.
note.es: Los cuatro medicamentos PrEP tienen cuatro resultados genericos diferentes. Truvada ha tenido competencia generica completa desde octubre de 2020, con multiples fabricantes vendiendo emtricitabina/tenofovir DF por $27 a $70 por mes con cupon de descuento. Descovy no tiene generico vendido en EE.UU. en 2026; la FDA ha otorgado aprobacion provisional a varios solicitantes genericos, pero los acuerdos de liquidacion de patentes probablemente mantendran el Descovy generico fuera de los estantes hasta entre 2032 y 2036. Apretude y Yeztugo son medicamentos de molecula pequena, no biologicos, por lo que la via de aprobacion de biosimilares no aplica a ninguno; ninguno tiene un cronograma generico anunciado en EE.UU. Un acuerdo de licencia global anunciado en septiembre de 2025 hara que el lenacapavir generico este disponible por aproximadamente $40 por persona al ano en unos 120 paises de bajos ingresos a partir de 2027, pero ese precio no se extiende al mercado de EE.UU.

caption.es: Elegibilidad PAP por tamano del hogar al 500% FPL, el umbral de Gilead Advancing Access y ViiV/GSKPAF (2026)

papEligibilityTable.source: HHS 2026 federal poverty guidelines (https://aspe.hhs.gov/poverty-guidelines) applied at Gilead Advancing Access's and ViiV/GSKPAF's approximately 500% FPL uninsured-patient threshold.

appealSteps.en: Step 1: Request a written explanation of benefits or denial notice showing the specific reason PrEP was denied or billed with cost-sharing. Under ACA rules and the Medicare PrEP NCD, most denials or copay charges for Truvada, Descovy, or Apretude are processing errors rather than valid coverage decisions.
appealSteps.es: Paso 1: Solicite una explicacion de beneficios o aviso de denegacion por escrito que muestre la razon especifica de la denegacion o el cobro.

appealSteps.en: Step 2: If your plan is ACA-compliant (most employer and Marketplace plans), cite Public Health Service Act Section 2713 and the plan's obligation to cover USPSTF Grade A preventive services, including PrEP, without cost-sharing when you call member services or file a formal appeal.
appealSteps.es: Paso 2: Si su plan cumple con la ACA, cite la Seccion 2713 de la Ley de Servicio de Salud Publica y la obligacion del plan de cubrir servicios preventivos sin costo compartido.

appealSteps.en: Step 3: For Medicare beneficiaries, cite the September 30, 2024 National Coverage Determination for HIV PrEP and ask the plan to reprocess the claim under Part B rather than Part D or standard drug cost-sharing.
appealSteps.es: Paso 3: Para beneficiarios de Medicare, cite la Determinacion Nacional de Cobertura del 30 de septiembre de 2024 y pida que el reclamo se reprocese bajo la Parte B.

appealSteps.en: Step 4: If the plan still denies coverage or improperly charges cost-sharing, escalate to your state Department of Insurance for commercial plans, or to Medicare's Independent Review process at 1-800-633-4227 for Part B disputes.
appealSteps.es: Paso 4: Si el plan sigue denegando la cobertura o cobrando indebidamente, escale al Departamento de Seguros de su estado o al proceso de Revision Independiente de Medicare.

stepTherapyOverride.en: Some insurers still require prior authorization or step therapy favoring generic Truvada before approving Descovy or Apretude. Federal preventive-services guidance limits how much reasonable medical management a plan can impose on a USPSTF-recommended service; your prescriber can document a specific clinical reason, for example a contraindication to tenofovir DF or a documented adherence barrier that makes a long-acting injectable more appropriate, to override step therapy.
stepTherapyOverride.es: Algunas aseguradoras aun requieren autorizacion previa o terapia escalonada favoreciendo el Truvada generico antes de aprobar Descovy o Apretude. Su prescriptor puede documentar una razon clinica especifica para anular la terapia escalonada.

papFallback.en: If appeals do not resolve the issue quickly enough, apply for Gilead Advancing Access (Truvada, Descovy, Yeztugo) or the ViiV Healthcare PAP through GSKPAF (Apretude) while the dispute continues. Both can supply medication at no cost within 5 to 10 business days for income-eligible uninsured patients.
papFallback.es: Si las apelaciones no resuelven el problema con suficiente rapidez, solicite Gilead Advancing Access o el PAP de ViiV Healthcare mientras continua la disputa.

genericAlternative.en: Generic Truvada (emtricitabine/tenofovir DF) at $27 to $70 per month is the lowest-cost fallback for patients whose plan disputes are unresolved, and it is the only one of the four PrEP drugs with broad generic availability. Discuss with your prescriber whether switching temporarily to generic Truvada is clinically appropriate while a coverage appeal for Descovy, Apretude, or Yeztugo is pending.
genericAlternative.es: El Truvada generico a $27 a $70 por mes es la alternativa de menor costo para pacientes cuyas disputas de plan no estan resueltas, y es el unico de los cuatro medicamentos PrEP con disponibilidad generica amplia.

en.question: Is there a generic for Truvada, Descovy, or Apretude?
en.answer: Yes for one of the three. Truvada has had a full generic (emtricitabine/tenofovir DF) since October 2020, costing $27 to $70 per month with a discount coupon. Descovy has no generic sold in the US as of 2026; patent settlements are expected to block generic sales until roughly 2032 to 2036. Apretude and the newer twice-yearly Yeztugo have no generic and no announced US timeline, since both are complex long-acting injectable formulations with their own patents.

en.question: How do I apply for a PrEP patient assistance program now that Ready, Set, PrEP has ended?
en.answer: Apply directly to the drug manufacturer. Gilead Advancing Access covers Truvada, Descovy, and Yeztugo for uninsured patients with household income at or below about 500 percent of the federal poverty level, no Social Security number required. The ViiV Healthcare Patient Assistance Program through GSKPAF covers Apretude at the same roughly 500 percent FPL threshold. Both require proof of income, proof of US residency, and a valid prescription, and typically process applications within 5 to 10 business days.

en.question: Can I use a PrEP manufacturer savings card with Medicare?
en.answer: No. Federal anti-kickback law bars manufacturer copay cards, including ViiVConnect, from being used by Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE, or VA beneficiaries. This restriction matters less for PrEP than for most drugs, however, because Medicare Part B has covered Truvada, Descovy, Apretude, and Yeztugo at $0 cost-sharing since a September 30, 2024 National Coverage Determination, so most Medicare beneficiaries do not need a savings card at all.

en.question: What if my insurance denies coverage or bills me for PrEP?
en.answer: Request a written denial notice or explanation of benefits, then file a formal appeal citing the ACA preventive-services mandate (Public Health Service Act Section 2713) for private plans or the 2024 Medicare National Coverage Determination for Part B claims. Most PrEP denials or copay charges in 2026 are processing errors rather than valid coverage decisions. If the appeal is not resolved quickly, apply for the manufacturer PAP as a temporary fallback.

en.question: Does Medicare cover PrEP for free in 2026?
en.answer: Yes. Since a September 30, 2024 National Coverage Determination, Medicare Part B covers all four FDA-approved PrEP drugs, oral Truvada and Descovy and the injectables Apretude and Yeztugo, with no deductible, copay, or coinsurance. Medicare also covers up to eight HIV tests per year, up to eight counseling sessions per year, and an annual hepatitis B screening at $0 as part of the same preventive-service benefit. The general 2026 Medicare Part D annual out-of-pocket cap of $2,100 does not apply to PrEP since it is billed under Part B, not Part D.

en.question: What does PrEP cost without insurance at the pharmacy counter in 2026?
en.answer: Generic Truvada costs $27 to $70 per month with a GoodRx coupon, the cheapest of the four options. Brand Descovy costs about $2,392 per month. Apretude costs $4,229 per bimonthly injection, roughly $2,115 per month on an equivalent basis. The newest option, Yeztugo, costs $14,109 per twice-yearly dose, about $28,218 per year. Uninsured patients at these cash prices should apply for Gilead Advancing Access or the ViiV Healthcare PAP instead of paying out of pocket.

en.question: Do I qualify for a PrEP patient assistance program based on my income?
en.answer: Both major PrEP manufacturer programs use roughly the same threshold: approximately 500 percent of the federal poverty level, which is $79,800 for a household of one in 2026 and $165,000 for a household of four. You must also be uninsured or have coverage that does not include the specific PrEP drug you need, and you must have a valid US prescription. Gilead Advancing Access does not require a Social Security number, making it accessible to undocumented residents.

en.question: What is the difference between Truvada, Descovy, Apretude, and Yeztugo?
en.answer: Truvada is a once-daily generic tablet approved for anyone at risk of sexually acquired or injection-drug-use HIV. Descovy is a once-daily brand tablet approved only for people at risk through anal sex, not for people whose only risk is receptive vaginal sex. Apretude is an injection given every two months, approved for adults and adolescents regardless of sex. Yeztugo, approved in June 2025, is an injection given only twice a year, the longest-acting PrEP option available as of 2026.

en.question: Does the IRA negotiated Medicare price apply to Truvada, Descovy, or Apretude?
en.answer: No. None of the four PrEP drugs was selected for Inflation Reduction Act price negotiation, so none carries a Medicare Maximum Fair Price, and none needed to be selected, since PrEP moved off the Part D formulary tier entirely in September 2024 and became a $0 cost-sharing Part B preventive service. The Inflation Reduction Act's negotiated-price mechanism exists to lower Part D drug costs; PrEP already costs Medicare beneficiaries $0, so the negotiation process simply does not apply here.

es.question: Hay un generico para Truvada, Descovy o Apretude?
es.answer: Si para uno de los tres. Truvada ha tenido un generico completo (emtricitabina/tenofovir DF) desde octubre de 2020, costando $27 a $70 por mes con un cupon de descuento. Descovy no tiene generico vendido en EE.UU. en 2026; los acuerdos de patentes probablemente bloquearan las ventas genericas hasta aproximadamente 2032 a 2036. Apretude y el nuevo Yeztugo dos veces al ano no tienen generico ni cronograma anunciado en EE.UU.

es.question: Como solicito un programa de asistencia al paciente para PrEP ahora que Ready, Set, PrEP ha terminado?
es.answer: Solicite directamente al fabricante del medicamento. Gilead Advancing Access cubre Truvada, Descovy y Yeztugo para pacientes sin seguro con ingresos familiares de hasta aproximadamente el 500 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza, sin requerir numero de Seguro Social. El Programa de Asistencia al Paciente de ViiV Healthcare a traves de GSKPAF cubre Apretude con el mismo umbral aproximado del 500 por ciento FPL.

es.question: Puedo usar una tarjeta de ahorro del fabricante de PrEP con Medicare?
es.answer: No. La ley federal anti-soborno prohibe las tarjetas de copago del fabricante, incluyendo ViiVConnect, para beneficiarios de Medicare, Medicaid, TRICARE o VA. Esta restriccion importa menos para la PrEP que para la mayoria de los medicamentos, sin embargo, porque Medicare Parte B ha cubierto Truvada, Descovy, Apretude y Yeztugo a $0 de costo compartido desde una Determinacion Nacional de Cobertura del 30 de septiembre de 2024.

es.question: Que hago si mi seguro deniega la cobertura o me cobra por la PrEP?
es.answer: Solicite un aviso de denegacion por escrito o una explicacion de beneficios, luego presente una apelacion formal citando el mandato de servicios preventivos de la ACA o la Determinacion Nacional de Cobertura de Medicare de 2024 para reclamos de la Parte B. La mayoria de las denegaciones o cobros de PrEP en 2026 son errores de procesamiento en lugar de decisiones de cobertura validas.

es.question: Cubre Medicare la PrEP de forma gratuita en 2026?
es.answer: Si. Desde una Determinacion Nacional de Cobertura del 30 de septiembre de 2024, Medicare Parte B cubre los cuatro medicamentos PrEP aprobados por la FDA, sin deducible, copago ni coseguro. Medicare tambien cubre hasta ocho pruebas de VIH por ano, hasta ocho sesiones de consejeria por ano y una prueba anual de hepatitis B a $0. El limite anual de bolsillo de la Parte D de Medicare de $2,100 para 2026 no aplica a la PrEP porque se factura bajo la Parte B.

es.question: Cuanto cuesta la PrEP sin seguro en la farmacia en 2026?
es.answer: El Truvada generico cuesta $27 a $70 por mes con un cupon de GoodRx, la opcion mas barata de las cuatro. Descovy de marca cuesta aproximadamente $2,392 por mes. Apretude cuesta $4,229 por inyeccion bimestral, aproximadamente $2,115 por mes de forma equivalente. La opcion mas nueva, Yeztugo, cuesta $14,109 por dosis dos veces al ano, aproximadamente $28,218 por ano.

es.question: Califico para un programa de asistencia al paciente de PrEP segun mis ingresos?
es.answer: Ambos programas principales de fabricantes de PrEP usan aproximadamente el mismo umbral: alrededor del 500 por ciento del nivel federal de pobreza, que es $79,800 para un hogar de uno en 2026 y $165,000 para un hogar de cuatro. Tambien debe carecer de seguro o tener cobertura que no incluya el medicamento PrEP especifico que necesita.

es.question: Cual es la diferencia entre Truvada, Descovy, Apretude y Yeztugo?
es.answer: Truvada es una tableta generica diaria aprobada para cualquier persona en riesgo de VIH por via sexual o por uso de drogas inyectables. Descovy es una tableta de marca diaria aprobada solo para personas en riesgo por sexo anal. Apretude es una inyeccion administrada cada dos meses, aprobada para adultos y adolescentes sin importar el sexo. Yeztugo, aprobado en junio de 2025, es una inyeccion administrada solo dos veces al ano, la opcion PrEP de accion mas prolongada disponible en 2026.

es.question: Aplica el precio negociado de la IRA a Truvada, Descovy o Apretude?
es.answer: No. Ninguno de los cuatro medicamentos PrEP fue seleccionado para la negociacion de precios de la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion, por lo que ninguno tiene un Precio Maximo Justo de Medicare, y no necesitaba serlo, ya que la PrEP salio por completo del nivel de formulario de la Parte D en septiembre de 2024 y se convirtio en un servicio preventivo de la Parte B con $0 de costo compartido.
